name: Luric Road: Dravesa to Orziben
terrain: Forest edge, then dry slopes of vines and olives. Sebkha to the east. 18 miles, one day.
frequency: Roll once in the morning and once in the afternoon.
description: Roll d12 for the kind of encounter, then roll on that table.

The road itself
The caravan of **Taziri n'Khaleb**, on its last leg. Sarit will meet it at the Salt Yard.
**Adval Cadek** riding east, asking every pilgrim whether they saw his son Jorun.
**Stravar Keln** riding east alone to see his estranged wife. Says it's caravan business.
**2d10 Schismatic pilgrims** from Dravesa, carrying Savar's letters of introduction to the Mountain of Fire.
Alum carts from **Maza ut Idir** going west for Dravesa's dye-works. An Idir cousin rides with them.
An apprentice of **Doran Vell** walking west to buy charcoal in Dravesa; Taziri's is late.
**1d6 Bandua raiders** from Vraed's hall scouting the forest edge for the seasonal raid.
**Sarit n'Khaleb** riding west to meet her mother's caravan early. Asks what the party saw on the Sebkha road.
A Fire-seer sent east by **Ilmath** with sealed instructions for **Cerin**. Ilmath knows the cleric is dead.
A cart sent by **Maret Duvall** for Orziben wine for the Gilded Ash.
An Idir cousin sent by **Amastan ut Idir** to ask Stravar Keln whether Dravesa's raiders would ride the Sebkha road for pay.
**Adval Cadek** pays travellers bound east to carry Jorun's description to the Salt Yard.
**Sarit n'Khaleb** asks westbound travellers to give Taziri a ledger page: Orziben prices have dropped.
A young Schismatic sent by **Savar** with letters for the pilgrims at the camp outside Orziben.

The forest falls back. The land dries. The first vine terraces.
Olive rows on the south slopes, dust on the leaves.
White alum smoke on the eastern horizon.
Sun-disks scratched on the milestones, all facing east.
A roadside well. Water 1cp a cup, Council price.
A footpath climbs into the northern hills. Orziben parents keep children off it.
A pilgrim's grave by the road: a sun-disk on a stick.
Nothing. Dust and cicadas.
